senses.gloss: a railing held up by posts
gloss_distractors: a flat stone floor outside a house
a long window in a roof
a small tower on a wall
senses.definition: A row of short posts with a rail on top, along the edge of stairs, a balcony, or a bridge.
senses.caution: It is a formal word from building and design. In everyday talk, railing or banister sounds more natural.
senses.example: Let us take the photo by the stone balustrade, where you can see the whole river behind us.

cues.text: You are writing up a site visit and need the exact word for the stone rail and posts along the hotel's terrace.
A safety report says the posts and rail along the edge of the office's upper floor are too low to meet code.
You describe the carved stone rail with short posts along the edge of an old palace balcony.
Guests lean on the row of short stone posts and rail along a terrace to watch the sunset.

distractors: A tall, narrow window set into a church wall.
A small tower on the corner of a castle.
A flat stone slab above a doorway that carries the weight of the wall.
A covered walkway with columns along one side of a large building, used for shelter from the rain.
A carved band of leaves and flowers that runs along the top edge of the walls in a grand room.
